title: /healthz no longer reflects the database at all, so a replica partitioned from Postgres stays in service
notes: /healthz now always answers 204. A single pod that permanently loses its path to Postgres (wrong DSN host, a network policy) is never taken out of service. db.Retry keeps its requests waiting until each client gives up. Alternative: fail /healthz only once db.Of(pool).Total() for the current outage exceeds a bound well above a switchover, such as 2 minutes.
